title: Datadog Reports Q3 2026 Revenue of $1.20 Billion, Up 35%
summary: Datadog reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.20 billion, up 35% year-over-year, non-GAAP EPS of $0.81 and its fourth-quarter 2026 outlook.
body_markdown:
"Datadog delivered a strong third quarter, with 35% year-over-year revenue growth, $290 million in operating cash flow, and $251 million in free cash flow," said Olivier Pomel, co-founder and CEO of Datadog. "We are seeing strong adoption across our platform as customers scale their digital operations and use of AI."


For the fourth quarter of 2026, Datadog guided revenue between $1.19 billion and $1.20 billion, non-GAAP operating income between $280 million and $290 million, and non-GAAP net income per share between $0.69 and $0.71. For the full year 2026, the company expects revenue between $4.515 billion and $4.525 billion, non-GAAP operating income between $1.095 billion and $1.105 billion, and non-GAAP net income per share between $2.73 and $2.75.


## Why It Matters for DDOG


Datadog said it had about 4,860 customers with ARR of $100,000 or more as of September 30, 2026, an increase of 20% from about 4,060 as of September 30, 2025. The release also says Datadog earned a Leader designation in the 2026 Forrester Wave for AIOps Platforms for the second consecutive year.
